blocks.text: 10" Android 15 Tablet with Case & Pen, 8GB RAM, 6000mAh Battery Discover the ultimate all-in-one solution with the 10-inch Android 15 Tablet. Featuring a durable protective case, a precise stylus pen, and a charging cable. Experience exceptional performance for work and entertainment with the latest Android 15 OS, 8GB（3GB + 5GB expansion）RAM for seamless multitasking, and a vibrant 10-inch display. Stay connected with advanced Wi-Fi 6, capture moments with the dual-camera system, and enjoy extended usage without frequent charges thanks to the robust 6000mAh battery. Get unparalleled value and convenience in one complete package, perfect for streaming, learning, and productivity on the go.

items.label: Android 15 & 8GB RAM
items.value: ​ Experience peak performance and the newest features with the pre-installed Android 15 operating system. The generous 8GB RAM (3GB + 5GB extended) ensures smooth multitasking, allowing you to effortlessly switch between apps, games, and videos without lag.

items.label: Long Lasting 6000mAh Battery electroinc tablets
items.value: ​ Enjoy all-day power for work and play. The high-capacity 6000mAh battery provides extended battery life for reading, streaming videos, attending online classes, or browsing the web without constantly needing an outlet.

items.label: Android Tablet Case＆Stylus
items.value: ​ This ultimate value package includes everything you need: a 10-inch tablet, a protective case to prevent scratches, a sensitive stylus for note-taking or drawing, and a charging cable. It's the perfect out-of-the-box solution for students and professionals.

items.label: 5G Wi-Fi 6 Connectivity
items.value: ​ Enjoy faster, more stable, and efficient internet connections with dual-band Wi-Fi 6 (2.4G & 5G). Stream HD content, download files, and video call with reduced buffering and improved performance, even on crowded networks.

items.label: Dual Cameras & 10" Display
items.value: ​ Perfect for video calls and casual photography with the dual-camera setup (2MP front + 8MP rear). The vibrant 10-inch HD screen offers an immersive experience for watching movies, playing games, and reading.
